title: MagLev World Record
description: With the flick of a spark the 846th Test Squadron's magnetically levitated sled system, or MagLev, broke a world record. Followed by a plume of smoke, the rocket propelled sled zipped down the 2,100 foot track at 633 miles per hour.

location.text: HOLLOMAN AIR FORCE BASE, NEW MEXICO, US
